title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Gokuu Den - Totsugeki Hen
aliases: Dragon Ball Z: Super Gokuu Den: Totsugeki Hen
description: Dragon Ball Z video game released in Japan that depicts events from Dragon Ball. Followed by DBZ Super Gokuden: Kakusei-Hen, which continues the story into Dragon Ball Z proper. Developed by TOSE and published by Bandai in 1995.
